shortDescription.text: Quantum-vulnerable ECDH: key wrapping and data encryption at rest (1 file(s))

fullDescription.text: 3 reference(s) to ECDH across 1 file(s), e.g. ethereum/p2p/src/main/java/org/hyperledger/besu/ethereum/p2p/rlpx/handshake/ecies/ECIESHandshaker.java:174. Role, judged from paths, function names and nearby code: key wrapping and data encryption at rest. Keys or data encrypted to these public keys are stored: anyone who copies them now decrypts them once a CRQC exists (harvest now, decrypt later). Wrap keys with ML-KEM or a hybrid KEM (X25519 + ML-KEM-768) and re-wrap the stored keys; data that may already have been copied needs its own assessment. This is a forward-looking risk that depends on the arrival of a cryptographically relevant quantum computer (CRQC). No such computer is publicly known to exist today; the timeline is uncertain. It is not a present-day exploitable vulnerability. Heuristic pattern match on source text without data-flow analysis. The usage context (security-relevant or not) must be confirmed manually; treat as preliminary.
